purpose: Durable, inspectable YOU automations whose background jobs cannot inherit broader authority than the automation grants.

module.rationale: Session/tool registry (ToolRegistry) and permission primitives live in hide-core; automations sit beside them as shared domain contracts, model-free.

authority_containment.property: A background agent cannot inherit broader authority than the automation grants.

mechanism.permission_set: Automation.permissions (PermissionSet) is the closed set of tools and connectors the automation grants.
mechanism.capability_derivation: AutomationJob.capability is obtained only via PermissionSet::derive_capability or PermissionSet::derive_capability_subset.
mechanism.non_widening: JobCapability fields are private; there is no public grant/add/widen API. Subset derivation rejects any tool/connector not in the parent set (CapabilityMissing).
mechanism.dispatch_gate: AutomationJob::use_tool calls JobCapability::require_tool before the fixture registry; unauthorized tools fail closed.
mechanism.recording: Unauthorized attempts are appended to RunResult.tool_attempts with authorized=false and stop_reason=AuthorityDenied{tool}.

durability.recovery: AutomationEngine::recover rebuilds the live map from durable records after process drop

stop_enforcement.effect: status=Stopped, stop_reason recorded, next_run_ms cleared; further manual runs refuse (InvalidState)

idempotent_triggers.mechanism: TriggerSpec::slot_if_due produces a stable slot key; Automation.fired_slots records fired slots; tick/fire_slot/run_slot no-op when the slot was already fired

clock.system: SystemClock available but wall-clock daemon wiring is deferred
clock.non_goal: No launchd, cron installation, or scheduling daemon

fixture_tools.note: No real connector or tool execution. standard_fixture_registry provides canned responses for email/calendar/fs/web/shell/notify stubs.

non_goals: real scheduling daemon / launchd / cron installation
